props.label: AI website builder
props.html:
Build

AI website builder

Describe the business and get a complete, on-brand multi-page site, sliced into editable sections.

Live visual editor

Click any text, image, icon or button to change it — add, move, clone or delete elements. No code.

Rich section backgrounds

Video, image and gradient backgrounds from YouTube or your own media library.

2,000+ icons & media

Font Awesome plus an outline set, and a media library for images and linkable PDFs.

Bulk import & shared parts

Import multiple pages, headers and footers at once; reuse shared headers & footers everywhere.

On-brand by default

AI matches your colours, fonts and voice, so it looks like your business from the first draft.

Host & secure — on Cloudflare

Global edge hosting

Served from hundreds of locations worldwide for near-instant loads, everywhere.

SSL, HTTPS & DDoS protection

Free SSL and DDoS protection, with no database or plugins to hack — a minimal attack surface.

Auto domain redirect

Your .pages.dev preview redirects to your real domain at go-live — no duplicate-content SEO problem.

Get leads

Spam-protected forms

Cloudflare Turnstile stops spam invisibly — no annoying puzzles for real customers.

Reliable email delivery

SMTP2GO delivers every enquiry to your inbox, with a branded lead email and a customer confirmation.

Leads inbox

Every enquiry captured in the dashboard, tagged with the page it came from — delete, restore and more.

Rank — SEO built in

Full on-page SEO

Titles, meta descriptions, sitemaps, structured data, canonical URLs and per-page index/no-index.

Live Google preview

See exactly how each page will look in Google results before you publish.

Speed that ranks

Edge-served static pages load near-instantly — the speed Google rewards.

Run at scale — for agencies

White-label dashboard

Rebrand the whole dashboard with your logo, colours and name — your brand, our tech.

Many sites, one login

Manage dozens of client sites from one place, with team roles and controlled client logins.

Fully managed

Hosting, security, SSL and technical upkeep handled for you — fewer moving parts, no surprise bills.
